description: Comply with all TCN licensing condition, the Electricity Act 2023, the ruling Documents and other applicable standards, codes and laws.
evidence: Internal compliance report; Legal opinion; NERC correspondence
notes: Breach attracts licence suspension/cancellation

description: Maintain adequate financial, technical and managerial resources to carry out the licensed activity in accordance with NERC regulations, codes, rules and service standards.
evidence: Annual resource adequacy report; Staffing records; Financial statements
notes: Tied to MYTO revenue requirement approval

description: Comply with all rules, codes and standards produced or approved by NERC, to the extent applicable to licensed activities.
evidence: Compliance audit report; Code adherence checklist
notes: Includes Grid Code, Market Rules, H&S Code, Metering Code

description: Comply with any orders, directions and determinations made by NERC pursuant to the Act, any Regulations or this Licence.
evidence: NERC orders register; Acknowledgement/response letters
deadline: Within timeframe stipulated in each directive
notes: Maintain a directives log updated within 5 business days of receipt

description: Furnish information to NERC in such manner and at such times as required; provide reports as NERC may consider necessary.
evidence: Information submission log; NERC acknowledgement receipts
notes: Failure constitutes non-compliance; maintain a requests tracker

description: Promptly provide detailed reports to NERC if TCN experiences a significant change in circumstances that materially affects ability to meet material obligations, or in the case of a major incident.
evidence: Incident/change notification letters; Proof of transmission to NERC
deadline: As soon as practicable after occurrence
notes: Major incidents must also be separately reported under H&S Code

description: Submit an annual report in respect of the licensed activity, including all financial, administrative, and technical aspects.
supporting: Finance & Accounts; Regulation & Compliance; Technical Audit
evidence: Signed annual report; Proof of submission to NERC
notes: Should align with RAR submission schedule

description: Notify NERC within 14 days of any change in registered address or changes to company registration details at CAC.
evidence: CAC notification letter; NERC notification letter with proof of delivery
notes: Track all corporate registration changes on a schedule

description: Notify NERC within 30 days of any change in facilities owned by the Licensee.
evidence: Asset change notification to NERC; Updated facilities register
notes: Coordinate with Engineering and MCS for facilities change log

description: Maintain a separate bank account for the Licensed (TSP) Activity, separate from System Operations accounts.
evidence: Bank account statement showing separate accounts; Auditor confirmation
notes: Regulatory Accounting Report (RAR) must confirm separation

description: Prepare and maintain separate financial accounts for the Licensed Activity in accordance with NERC guidelines and best commercial accounting practices.
evidence: Separate financial statements for TSP; Auditor's report
notes: Format/content subject to NERC guidelines

description: Submit a copy of auditors' report stating whether accounting statements are properly prepared and give a true and fair view of the licensed activity's finances.
evidence: External auditors' report; Submission evidence to NERC
notes: Auditor must be CAMA-compliant

description: Prepare and submit a Regulatory Accounting Report (RAR) containing financial and accounting statements as prescribed by NERC.
evidence: Signed RAR; Proof of submission to NERC
notes: Guidelines for RAR form and content issued by NERC

description: Not unduly discriminate between any persons, users, classes of users, or between TCN affiliates and any other person or user in carrying out transmission obligations.
evidence: Connection offers log; Tariff schedules; User complaints register
notes: Discrimination complaints attract enforcement action by NERC

description: Pay to NERC Annual Operating Fees of 1.5% of Licensee's Charges/kWh as specified in NERC Licence and Operating Fees Regulations 2010, monthly.
evidence: Monthly payment receipts; NERC annual operating fee schedule
deadline: Monthly (per Market Settlement and Payment Calendar)
notes: Delayed payments attract 1% above prevailing inter-bank lending rate

description: Adopt and implement reasonable and prudent insurance policies to manage insurance risks associated with the licensed activity. Ensure all transmission equipment and facilities are adequately insured.
evidence: Current insurance policy documents; Asset insurance schedule; Annual insurance review report
notes: Coordinate with insurers for comprehensive asset coverage

description: Grant NERC and its authorised agents right of access to inspect TCN's premises, equipment, and documents, and render necessary assistance during inspection.
evidence: Access facilitation records; Inspection reports; Correspondence with NERC
notes: Prepare and maintain access-ready documentation at all sites

description: Procure assets and services through an open, transparent and competitive process, employing best corporate practices. Obtain NERC approval before purchases outside approved budgets.
evidence: Tender documents; Evaluation reports; Contract awards; NERC approval for off-budget purchases
notes: Must follow Public Procurement Act 2007 and TCN Procurement Policy

description: Prepare and maintain a register of all assets in a form specified by NERC. Submit register to NERC no later than 6 months after licence commencement and annually thereafter.
evidence: Updated asset register; Proof of submission to NERC
deadline: Annually (and within 6 months of any new licence)
notes: Register must include all assets with book value >₦10,000,000

description: Give NERC not less than 21 days prior notice of intention to dispose of any relevant asset (book value ₦10m), together with supporting information.
evidence: Asset disposal notice to NERC; NERC consent letter; Disposal transaction records
notes: Await NERC written consent or expiry of 21-day period without objection

description: Keep a record of performance with respect to applicable performance and reliability standards; submit KPI reports (SAIDI, SAIFI, Forced Outage, Transmission Losses, etc.) to NERC monthly, quarterly, bi-annually, and annually as scheduled.
supporting: Technical Audit; Transmission Services; Corporate Planning; PC&M
evidence: Completed KPI report forms (Schedule 2); Proof of submission to NERC; Performance data extracts
deadline: Monthly (by end of month); Quarterly; Bi-annually; Annually
notes: Covers SAIDI, SAIFI, Forced Outages, Transformer Utilisation, Transmission Losses, Significant Incidents, CAPEX/OPEX

description: Prepare and maintain a written environmental compliance policy. Report to NERC on compliance with environmental regulations in form and at times prescribed by NERC.
evidence: Environmental policy document; Environmental compliance report to NERC; Environmental audit reports
deadline: Annual policy review; Periodic as prescribed by NERC
notes: Coordinate with Federal Ministry of Environment for EIA compliance on new projects

description: Take all reasonable steps to protect persons and property from injury and damage. Comply with all applicable Nigerian laws(NESI) and regulations relating to health and safety of employees and the public.
supporting: Medicals; Engineering; Transmission Services; All Departments
evidence: H&S policy; Accident register; H&S compliance reports; Inspection records
notes: The Nigeria Electricity Health & Safety Code 2014 provides detailed mandatory requirements

description: Take all reasonable steps to detect and prevent theft of electricity, damage to any part of the transmission system, or interference with metering equipment.
evidence: Security incident log; CCTV monitoring records; Metering tamper detection reports
notes: Inform affected users where theft or metering interference is suspected

description: Obtain written NERC approval before engaging in any supplementary activities to the licensed activity. Ensure supplementary activities do not compromise financial or technical capabilities.
supporting: Corporate Planning; Finance & Accounts; Regulation & Compliance
evidence: NERC approval letters; Supplementary activity register; Financial impact assessment
deadline: Before commencement of any supplementary activity
notes: Applies to any commercial activity beyond core TSP mandate

description: Monitor compliance with this Licence and report any non-compliance to NERC. Conduct annual independent compliance audit of Market Rules, Grid Code, and other regulations. Submit audit results to NERC upon completion.
evidence: Annual compliance audit report (by independent auditor); Submission to NERC; Non-compliance register
notes: Independent auditor must be appointed by TCN; NERC may also conduct its own audits

description: Not assign or transfer this licence without prior written consent of NERC.
evidence: NERC consent letter for any assignment; Board resolutions; Legal opinions
notes: Board and Ministry approval likely also required

description: Not enter into or permit changes to ownership/management without NERC prior written approval. Give NERC 30 days notice for share capital changes exceeding 5%.
supporting: Corporate Planning; Finance & Accounts; Regulation & Compliance
evidence: NERC approval/consent letters; CAC filing evidence; 30-day notice letters
deadline: At least 30 days before ownership or management changes
notes: Includes changes to Board and senior management structure

description: Participate in industry panels and workgroups set up by NERC to develop, amend, or modify Regulations, Rules, Codes, and Standards.
evidence: Panel participation records; Meeting minutes; Written nominations to NERC
notes: Designate representatives to attend NERC-convened panels promptly

description: Obtain NERC approval for all tariffs and charges before implementation. Apply for approval of any tariff changes. File and keep open for public inspection all rate schedules and charges in force.
evidence: NERC tariff approval letters; Published tariff schedules; Public inspection records
deadline: Before implementing any tariff change; Annual tariff filing
notes: Align with MYTO cycle; Tariff schedules must be publicly accessible

description: Resolve disputes between TCN and NERC, or other licensees, in accordance with the dispute resolution mechanism established by NERC.
evidence: Dispute register; Correspondence records; NERC determination letters
notes: All market-related disputes also governed by Market Rules and Grid Code

description: Protect the confidentiality of information about users and applicants for connection to the transmission system. Disclose only with written consent or for permitted purposes.
evidence: Data confidentiality policy; User consent forms; Data breach register
notes: Breach of confidentiality attracts NERC enforcement action

description: Enter into network connection and use of system agreements (TUoS agreements) with all eligible users and licensees.
evidence: Executed connection agreements; TUoS agreements; Grid connection agreement register
deadline: Within timeframe stipulated by Grid Code (not >3 months)
notes: No user to be connected without a valid agreement

description: Not lessen or discontinue transmission services to any user except as provided for in agreements or in accordance with procedures approved by NERC.
evidence: Service continuity records; User notification for any service reduction; NERC approval where required
notes: Emergency disconnection procedures must be pre-approved by NERC

description: When a licensee or eligible customer applies for connection, make an offer in accordance with the Grid Code. Notify NERC and applicant within 3 months if connection refused, stating reasons.
evidence: Connection application log; Connection offer letters; Refusal notifications to NERC and applicants
notes: Offer terms must comply with Grid Code, Market Rules, and safety standards

description: TCN (TSP) shall not purchase or sell electricity.
evidence: Financial records confirming no electricity trading; Compliance declaration
notes: Any electricity trading constitutes a fundamental breach of licence

description: Design, construct and commission transmission facilities in compliance with approved standards and codes. Develop annual/long-term maintenance schedule. Notify NERC of all scheduled maintenance and outages per Grid Code. Ensure no facility is abandoned without adequate maintenance.
evidence: Annual maintenance schedule; NERC outage notifications; Maintenance logs; Grid Code compliance reports
notes: Transmission losses exceeding NERC standards attract financial penalty

description: Submit transmission revenue requirement data and system investment plan to NERC for each financial year. Obtain NERC prior written approval for major transmission investments.
evidence: Annual revenue requirement submission; Investment plan; NERC approval letters
notes: Major investment threshold defined by NERC on case-by-case basis

description: Charge for connection and use of transmission system only per NERC-approved tariffs. Prepare and maintain NERC-approved statement of connection and TUoS charges.
evidence: NERC-approved charge schedules; Billing records; Published tariff statements
notes: Over/undercharging constitutes non-compliance; tariff schedule to be publicly filed

description: Assist and support System Operator on all issues relating to planning, expansion and reinforcement of the transmission system. Implement projects listed in the long-term expansion plan approved by NERC.
evidence: Long-term expansion plan; Project implementation status reports; NERC-approved annual report
notes: Align with Nigeria Transmission Expansion Plan (NTEP)

description: Install power factor monitoring devices and equipment ensuring power factor attains prescribed levels. Set out parties' obligations for power factor improvement devices in user agreements.
evidence: Power factor monitoring equipment records; User agreement provisions; Power factor measurement logs
notes: Power factor penalty/compensation schedule to be NERC-approved

description: Install, maintain, and verify accuracy of meter installations at all transmission network take-off points. Ensure meter calibration by an independent NERC-certified agency. Comply with Market Rules, Grid Code, and Metering Code requirements.
supporting: Transmission Services; Finance & Accounts; Regulation & Compliance
evidence: Meter installation and calibration records; Independent calibration certificates; Metering Code compliance report
notes: Metering data used for market settlement – inaccuracy attracts financial liability

description: Plan and maintain the transmission system to provide efficient and economical transmission services in accordance with approved planning standards, reliability standards, and the Grid Code.
evidence: Grid Code compliance certificate; Planning studies; Reliability performance reports
notes: Annual power system studies to be submitted to NERC/System Operator

description: Give NERC 24 months advance notice of intent to close or reduce transmission capacity on a permanent basis, with technical and economic justification.
supporting: Legal; SP&D; Corporate Planning; Regulation & Compliance
evidence: 24-month advance notice letter to NERC; Technical/economic justification report; NERC approval
notes: NERC must approve closure programme before action is taken

description: Rights and obligations of the TSP as provided in Technical Codes, Market Rules, TUoS Agreements, and licence terms and conditions in relation to eligible customers.
evidence: TUoS agreement register; Grid Code compliance evidence; Market Rules adherence records
notes: Review eligible customer TUoS agreements annually for compliance

description: Communicate decision on applications for third-party access to the transmission network to the applicant within 30 working days of submission of complete documentation.
evidence: Application log with timestamps; Decision letters; NERC notification where access denied
deadline: Within 30 working days of complete documentation
notes: Unreasonable denial of access attracts NERC sanction

description: Where third-party access is denied due to lack of capacity, communicate reasons for the refusal to the applicant.
evidence: Written denial letter with stated capacity reasons; NERC notification of denial
notes: Aggrieved party may petition NERC against denial

description: Execute Transmission Use of System (TUoS) Agreement with eligible customers prior to commencement of energy delivery through the transmission network.
evidence: Executed TUoS agreements; Eligible customer register; NERC approval documentation
notes: TUoS agreement must be initialled at NERC Stage 2 approval and executed at Stage 3

description: Ensure metering infrastructure for eligible customers has communication module for remote reading by System Operator; comply with Metering Code requirements for billing and settlement.
evidence: Meter installation certificates; Remote reading capability confirmation; Metering Code compliance records
deadline: Before commencement of eligible customer transactions
notes: System Operator has obligation to remotely read trading meters at injection points

description: Conduct and submit power system planning studies including load flow analysis, fault level calculations, stability assessments and network studies at required intervals to ensure system reliability.
supporting: Technical Audit; Regulation & Compliance; Transmission Services
evidence: Annual planning studies; Transmission Expansion Plan; NERC/SO submission records
deadline: Annual studies; Interim studies upon system changes
notes: Planning data to be shared with System Operator

description: Ensure all connections to the transmission network comply with Grid Code connection conditions, including voltage, frequency, protection, and metering requirements.
evidence: Connection compliance certificates; Grid Code connection condition checklists; Technical connection reports
deadline: Before energisation of each new connection
notes: Non-compliant connections must not be energised

description: Maintain operational compliance with Grid Code requirements including voltage and frequency control, outage planning, emergency procedures, and dispatch instructions.
evidence: Operational logs; Outage records; Frequency/voltage monitoring reports; Dispatch compliance records
notes: Regional GMs to maintain operations logs and escalate Grid Code deviations

description: Maintain and operate metering systems at all connection points in compliance with Grid Code Metering Code requirements for accuracy, communication and settlement purposes.
evidence: Metering audit reports; Calibration certificates; Meter data management records
notes: Settlement meter data feeds directly into market payment cycle

description: Configure, install, test, and maintain protection, control and SCADA systems for all transmission lines, substations and equipment to Grid Code and international standards.
evidence: Protection coordination studies; Relay test records; Protection settings register; SCADA maintenance logs
notes: Non-compliant protection settings risk grid collapse

description: Provide all operational data, performance reports and outage notifications to System Operator as required by the Grid Code.
supporting: Regulation & Compliance; Technical Audit; All Regions
evidence: Data submission records; SO acknowledgements; Outage notification logs
notes: System Operator data requirements include real-time and periodic data

description: Comply with all Market Rules obligations applicable to the Transmission Service Provider, including maintaining valid Market Participation Agreements.
evidence: Market Participation Agreement; Annual compliance declaration; Market Rules breach register
notes: TCN as TSP must maintain market participant status

description: Post required financial securities/guarantees as specified by Market Rules, and maintain Letter of Credit or Bank Guarantee in favour of Market Operator.
evidence: Letter of Credit / Bank Guarantee documents; Market Operator acknowledgement; Security register
notes: Insufficient security attracts market suspension

description: Comply with monthly market settlement procedures, submit timely billing and energy data, and pay all market charges and obligations in accordance with the Annual Market Settlement and Payment Calendar.
supporting: Treasury Management Services; Business Development/TUoS; PC&M
evidence: Monthly settlement statements; Payment receipts; Market Operator correspondence
notes: Settlement data accuracy tied to metering; late payments attract interest

description: Undertake annual compliance audit of Market Rules adherence as required under Licence Condition 17.3.
evidence: Annual compliance audit report; Independent auditor appointment letter; NERC submission
notes: Must be conducted by independent auditor appointed by TCN

description: Provide a safe work environment for all employees and contractors engaged in transmission, substation, and maintenance activities. Conduct risk assessment for all activities involving electrical equipment.
supporting: Medicals; HR; Engineering; Transmission Services; Procurement
evidence: H&S policy document; Risk assessment records; Safe work procedures
notes: Legal obligation under H&S Code; NERC may impose penalties for breach

description: Provide, maintain and ensure use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for all workers at transmission stations, substations, and field work sites.
supporting: Engineering; Transmission Services; All Regions; Works & Services
evidence: PPE procurement records; PPE distribution register; Site inspection reports
notes: PPE requirements differ by voltage level and work type

description: Implement and enforce a formal work permit system for all work on or near energised electrical equipment and transmission infrastructure.
supporting: Engineering; Transmission Services; All Regions; Works & Services
evidence: Completed work permit forms; Permit issuer register; Permit to work logs
notes: Permit to Work (PTW) system is mandatory for all high-voltage work

description: Report all workplace accidents, injuries, near-misses, and fatalities in accordance with H&S Code requirements. Investigate all incidents and implement corrective actions.
evidence: Accident/incident register; Incident investigation reports; NERC incident notification letters; Corrective action logs
deadline: Within 24 hours for serious incidents; 7 days for investigation report
notes: Major incidents must also be reported to NERC per Licence Condition 4.2

description: Develop, maintain and test emergency response plans for all electrical incidents, including electrocution, fire, explosion, and major equipment failure at transmission stations and substations.
supporting: Medicals; CSSD; All Regions; Transmission Services
evidence: Emergency response plan documents; Drill/exercise records; Review certificates
deadline: Annual drills; Plan review every 2 years
notes: Emergency response to include medical response coordination with Medicals dept

description: Ensure all personnel observe mandatory minimum approach distances for energised transmission equipment at all voltage levels, as specified in the H&S Code.
supporting: Engineering; Transmission Services; All Regions; Works & Services
evidence: Site safety rules; Training records; Toolbox talk logs; Site inspection reports
notes: Approach distance charts to be displayed at all substations and work sites

description: Train all employees and contractors on health, safety and environmental requirements applicable to their work activities, including electrical safety, first aid, and emergency procedures.
evidence: Training attendance records; Training completion certificates; Curriculum/programme; Trainer qualifications
notes: Training records to be maintained per employee

description: Ensure that all contractors working on TCN's transmission infrastructure comply with H&S Code requirements, including risk assessment, permit to work, and PPE.
supporting: Procurement; Engineering; Works & Services; Transmission Services
evidence: Contractor H&S compliance requirements in contracts; Contractor safety audit reports; Contractor incident records
notes: H&S requirements must be embedded in procurement documents and contracts

description: Design and construct all transmission lines, substations, and associated infrastructure in accordance with the Nigeria Electricity Supply and Installation Standards Regulations 2015.
supporting: Works & Services; SP&D; Technical Audit; Procurement
evidence: Engineering design documents stamped with applicable standards; Design review/approval records
deadline: At each project design and construction phase
notes: NESIS Regulations reference international standards (IEC, BS, etc.)

description: Ensure that all electrical materials, equipment and components procured for transmission infrastructure meet NESIS specifications and quality standards.
supporting: Material Control & Stores; Engineering; Technical Audit
evidence: Technical specifications in bid documents; Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) certificates; Type test reports; Conformance certificates
notes: Works closely with MCS for incoming material inspection

description: Install all electrical systems and equipment in accordance with NESIS Regulations standards for safe, compliant, and reliable installations.
supporting: Works & Services; Technical Audit; Transmission Services
evidence: Installation quality control records; Third-party inspection reports; Commissioning test results
notes: Applies to both new projects and upgrades to existing infrastructure

description: Support and facilitate the eligible customer regime established under the Electricity Act 2023, ensuring compliance with NERC's declarations and requirements for eligible customer transactions on the transmission network.
evidence: Eligible customer register; TUoS agreement log; NERC correspondence on eligible customers
notes: EA 2023 significantly expands eligible customer regime

description: Coordinate and cooperate with the Nigeria Independent System Operator (NISO) on system planning, operations, and expansion in accordance with the Electricity Act 2023.
supporting: Corporate Planning; Transmission Services; Regulation & Compliance
evidence: NISO coordination meeting records; Data sharing agreements; Planning coordination reports
notes: NISO established under 2023 EA replaces earlier System Operator structure

description: Comply with any obligations imposed by NERC regarding contributions to the Rural Electrification Fund as applicable to TCN's operations.
evidence: NERC directives on REF contributions; Payment records; NERC correspondence
notes: Monitor NERC pronouncements on REF contribution rates

description: Comply with any NERC determination on contribution to the Power Consumer Assistance Fund as applicable to TCN's eligible customer transactions.
evidence: NERC directives on PCAF contributions; Payment records
notes: Rate to be determined by NERC per ECR 2024 Regulation 26

description: Comply with local, regional, and international labour laws and regulations, including conditions of service, union recognition (NUEE and SSAEC), and workplace dispute management.
evidence: Collective Bargaining Agreements; Grievance registers; Labour law compliance audits; Court/industrial court records
notes: Engage NUEE and SSAEC proactively; avoid strikes and work stoppages

description: Maintain accurate, complete and accessible corporate and regulatory records, including contracts, correspondence, reports, and operational logs, as required by various regulatory instruments.
evidence: Records management policy; Document control system; Records retention schedule
notes: Records to be available for NERC inspections at any time

description: Engage with local communities to address concerns related to transmission infrastructure, promote public awareness about protecting power installations, and prioritise host community members in junior staff recruitment. Provide basic social amenities near TCN work locations.
evidence: Community engagement records; Stakeholder meeting minutes; CSR activity reports; Recruitment records showing host community priority
notes: Required under Electricity Act and general good governance practice

description: Maintain adequate cybersecurity measures and data protection controls for all TCN IT systems, operational technology, and corporate data, to prevent breaches and ensure compliance with applicable data protection laws.
evidence: Cybersecurity policy; Annual vulnerability assessment reports; Data breach register; NDPR compliance evidence
notes: Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR) 2019 also applies to TCN

description: Conduct all procurement activities in strict compliance with the Public Procurement Act 2007, NERC procurement guidelines, and TCN's internal procurement policies. Maintain integrity in tendering, evaluation, and award of contracts.
supporting: Finance & Accounts; Legal; Audit; Risk Management
evidence: Procurement procedure compliance checklists; BPP approval records; Contract award notifications; Vendor due diligence records
notes: Bureau of Public Procurement (BPP) oversight applies to TCN as a federal government entity

description: Prepare and submit accurate, timely, and audited financial statements to applicable authorities, including NERC, in compliance with IFRS/IPSAS, and Companies and Allied Matters Act (CAMA).
supporting: Audit; Regulation & Compliance; Treasury Management Services
evidence: Audited annual financial statements; External auditors' report; Submission receipts
deadline: Annually (90 days after financial year end)
notes: As a government entity, TCN also subject to Fiscal Responsibility Act

description: Monitor, evaluate and report on the performance of all transmission infrastructure projects and departmental activities, including donor-funded projects, to stakeholders including NERC, government, and funding agencies.
supporting: Corporate Planning; Program Coordination; All Departments
evidence: Monthly performance reports; Project implementation status reports; Donor reporting packages
notes: All departments to submit monthly reports to M&E

description: Identify, assess, mitigate, monitor, and report risks across all of TCN's operations, financial activities, and infrastructure in accordance with ISO 31000 and applicable regulatory expectations.
evidence: Risk register; Risk assessment reports; Business continuity plan; Insurance schedule; Quarterly risk reports to Management
notes: Align with ISO 31000; report to Board Risk Committee
